answer: Trust-graph ranking spots Sybils by how they connect. Reputation flows from a few seeded honest agents along real paid interactions, using short random walks. Fakes can link to each other freely, but trust only reaches them through scarce edges to honest agents, like water seeping into a hollow over one thin ridge. To raise his army's rank, an attacker must win genuine deals with real agents, one costly edge at a time; otherwise his whole cluster stays a dim umber patch on the map.
